title: Quiz engine and UI with seed question bank

history.detail:
CONDITIONAL: QA1 gate-1 audit, sprint 1, audited commit a03a9c5 (code identical to fe1aca0; a03a9c5 only fills in the approvals section of the sprint file). The sprint file was re-read fresh before this verdict.

VERDICT: CONDITIONAL. One confirmed requirement defect (R3/AC3). Everything else meets its criterion.

REQUIRED FIX (blocking):
1. R3 duplicate-id check ignores the "Comparisons ignore case and leading/trailing whitespace" rule. site/js/validate.js keys firstIndexOfId on the raw entry.id, so R3's rule is applied to 2 of its 3 listed comparisons (distractor vs correctAnswer, duplicate choices) and not to the third (duplicate id). README narrowed the rule to match ("Comparisons for 'same answer' ignore case..."), which is not what R3 says. Repro, run from repo root against validateQuestions:
   ["order-001","ORDER-001"]   -> 0 problems   (should be 1: duplicate id)
   ["order-001"," order-001 "] -> 0 problems   (should be 1: duplicate id)
   ["order-001","order-001"]   -> 1 problem    (correct)
   The CLI (npm run validate) calls the same function, so the automated check lets both through. Fix: key the duplicate map on normalize(entry.id) and report the original id in the message. Add tests for the case-variant and whitespace-variant duplicate ids that assert the message names the id. Correct the README sentence to state the rule as R3 does. This is a code-only change: site/data/questions.json must NOT change, so the R14 approval at fe1aca0 stays valid. If the data file changes, it needs product-owner re-approval.

CRITERIA, checked:
AC1 Met. README documents the Actions workflow and the exact setting (Pages source: GitHub Actions). No root-absolute URLs in site/. Assets are relative, the data URL is resolved from import.meta.url, and the favicon is inline so there is no /favicon.ico 404.
AC2 Met. site/data/questions.json is separate from the code. The validator enforces exactly the R2 fields (missing and extra fields are both flagged), their types, the four categories, 3 distractors, and a one-line fact.
AC3 NOT MET, see fix 1. Otherwise good: every other R3 violation is tested and the tests assert that the message names the id, including through the CLI's stderr and not just its exit code.
AC4 Met, mechanically. 12 entries, 3 per category, no current/most-recent phrasing, and order-003 uses 22nd and 24th. No Trump question. Historical accuracy is NOT certified by QA1; that is R14's job.
AC5 Met. Skewed-bank tests (30/2/2/2 and 40/1/1/1). The test proves the naive draw fails over 10% of the time, so the rule is actually being exercised. The engine enforces the rule itself and fails loudly if the invariant is broken.
AC6 Met. Over 500 rounds the correct answer lands in all 4 slots, each at 20-30% share. Each question's choice order also varies between showings.
AC7 Met. The handler disables every choice before calling session.answer(). answer() sets the lock before touching the score and returns null for any later call. Tests cover double-click, switched answers, and a same-tick burst. There is no double-fire path.
AC8 Met. The copy matches exactly. The em dash is U+2014, confirmed from the file bytes (E2 80 94), and the full stop is present. Marking uses tag text (a check or cross plus the words), a dashed vs solid border, and colour.
AC9 Met. Screens and labels are exact. Play again builds a new QuizSession, so the score resets with no page reload (grep finds no reload anywhere). Next is hidden until an answer is given, and nothing is timed.
AC10 Met. No fixed widths, overflow-wrap is anywhere, choices are width 100%, and .btn has a 44px minimum.
AC11 Met. Choices are real buttons and the feedback is in role=status aria-live=polite. Focus goes to the question heading after Next and on the first question, to Next after an answer, and to the results heading at the end. The focus ring is visible.
AC12 Met. QA1 ran npm test on Node 24.21.0: 54/54 pass. npm run validate: OK on 12 questions.
AC13 Met. No storage, cookie, beacon, analytics, or external request anywhere in site/. The only URL is the SVG namespace string in the inline icon.
AC14 Met. The approvals section records fe1aca0 and quotes the product owner's "Approved". git diff fe1aca0 a03a9c5 -- site/data/questions.json is empty.

ADVISORY (non-blocking, not required for PASS):
a. Live-region timing: feedback-text is set while #feedback is display:none and the region is un-hidden in the same tick. Some screen reader and browser combinations do not announce a region that enters the accessibility tree already filled. Suggest keeping the region always rendered and toggling only its content. Worth a real check by LiveQA or sprint 3's a11y audit.
b. main.js validates the bank's shape but not whether it covers at least 3 categories. A bank that is valid but covers too few categories would make drawRound throw inside the Start click handler. That exception is uncaught and the student sees nothing. This can't happen with the current data. Consider checking it in loadBank so it reaches the #load-error path.
